stdout:
On builder-1, run:

  curl -fsSL https://fleetd.sh | sh -s -- --join http://127.0.0.1:4790 --code fle_CODE --machine-id builder-1

The code works once, until HH:MM UTC. builder-1 needs claude installed and must reach the workspace at that address.

The workspace is only at http://127.0.0.1:4790, which no other machine reaches, so only a node on the workspace's own computer can join it. For another machine, give the workspace its tailnet or LAN address: on the workspace's machine, run fleetd init --listen <ip>:<port> --url http://<name>:<port> (Settings › Workspace › Setup › Where the workspace listens), then try again.
